timestampSemantics: scrapedAt is export assembly time (preserved on unchanged content), not collection time; message timestamps are in provenance; see delivery coverage for the stored harvest capture window.
format: eql-companion-ai data envelope: { schemaVersion, scrapedAt, source, kind, count, records }
note: Attributed Discord claims, not independently verified facts. provenance.origin identifies the server, not claim authority. provenance.date is the message date; patch date is the effective update date. QA answers retain relationship evidence; same-conversation means an unverified candidate. supportingEvidence is linked context, not an asserted answer. Raw Discord archives are excluded. Coverage gaps describe unavailable sources.

patchNotes.source: Discord — the official EverQuest Legends server (guild 1435786469968183456), #patch-notes channel. One record per game update, split into dated, sectioned, per-bullet changes. Every record links to the Discord message.
coverageGaps: The stored harvest recorded fifteen channels as permission-blocked (HTTP 403; not rechecked by this offline export), including officer-chat, raiders-lounge, event-prep, discipline-log, copy-list, officer applications and shareholders on the guild server, and mod-chat, known-issues and developer-only on the official server. Access depends on Discord permissions; this offline export makes no claim about current credential capabilities.

coverageGaps: The stored harvest recorded fifteen channels as permission-blocked (HTTP 403; not rechecked by this offline export); see the coverage note in the manifest.

prices.source: Discord — the Afterlife EQL guild server (guild 1528946134381367347), #guild-shop and #wts-wtb-wtt-free. Guild shop rates and member market trades, keyed by market AND date AND item. These are Discord-posted GUILD prices, NOT Bazaar observations: a guild rate must never be written over a Bazaar quote. NOTE: the guild's current WTS/WTB lists are posted as images, so those specific numbers are NOT in this file.
coverageGaps: The guild's current WTS/WTB price lists are posted as PNG images. The text messages are only headers pointing at them, so the numbers in those lists were not extracted. This file holds the rates that were posted as TEXT (the guild bank WTB list) and the market prices stated in prose.
